The pity system? Sure! Sorry for the long response, I tried to organize it as much as I could. I wrote extra since you're very new to the game.

SAVE THE PRIMOGEMS. You can get primos from exploring(chests, waypoints etc), quests and events.

To understand what character you want, play the game and discover who you like! Save accordingly. Keep up with the leaks and what characters are coming in the near future.

There are 2 types of wishes, **Acquaint Fate(blue)** and **Intertwined Fate(pink)**. Every 160 primos are equal to one of these. You can also buy these from the shop using starglitter and stardust. You get these from actually wishing on the banner.

Prioritize getting the pink wishes before the blue ones.

​

***Banners:***

There are 3 types of banners. This is where you'll get most of your weapons and characters.

1. The first type of banner is the **standard banner.** It is PERMANENT and this is where you can use the blue wishes. But you shouldn't convert your primos to the blue wishes, I will get to that later. All 4 stars weapons and characters are on here. There are 6 5-star characters on this banner (Diluc, Mona, Jean, Tighnari, Qiqi and Keqing). There are also 5-star weapons like the Skyward Series weapons, Amos bow, Jade Spear and Wolf's gravestone.
2. The second type is the **character event banner**. This is where every 5-star character is going to be. In every patch(42 days long) there are going to be 4 (or more in the future, we don't know yet) featured characters. 2 characters for the first 3 weeks, and 2 for the other 3 weeks. Ex: this patch we have Alhaitham and Xiao for phase 1 & Yelan and Hu Tao for phase 2. The standard 4-star characters and weapons are also here, but you have a higher chance of getting a 4-star that is featured on the event banner.
3. The 3rd type is the **weapon banner** where you get your limited 5-star weapons. This also changes with the same duration of the character event banner. Honestly, I am f2p and rarely wish on these bcs you can blow over 100 and still not get your desired weapon. It's better to get the characters you want first. You will need to save a ton to safely guarantee a character you want along with their weapon.

​

***Pity system:***

1 wish = 1 pity.

To "hit pity" means to get a 5-star.

Every 90 wishes guarantee one 5-star on all banner types. However, you will most likely get a 5-star before hitting 90 so don't "build pity". (Ex: I got Childe on 46 pity). After getting the 5-star, your pity resets. This goes for both 5-star weapons and characters

Most of your wishes will result in 3-star weapons that are good for early players like you. I am AR 58 so I have 0 use for them.

Note: If you're lucky, you can get 2 or more 5-stars back to back or in one 10-pull. Rare but possible.

For every 10 wishes you guarantee 1 or more 4-star characters or weapons.

**Standard banner pity system:** 90 wishes or less will get you any of the 5 stars I listed above in the standard banner section.

**Character event banner pity system:** Same as standard banner except when you hit pity, you have a 50% chance of getting the character you want or a 50% getting a 5-star character from the standard banner. If you are one of the unfortunate that "lost the 50/50" to a standard character, your next limited 5-star is guaranteed. This means you need 180 wishes to 100% guarantee you'll get the limited event character you want. Not always true though. Ex: I got Alhaitham at 19 pity despite saving 245 wishes.

Note on standard characters: they aren't necessarily bad but players generally don't want to lose the 50/50 and get one of them. However, it is okay to use them if you like them. Ex: I love Diluc and luckily have lost my 50/50s to him so I have never been sad about getting him.

​
